newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn raises yield on 5-year Bobl bonds.
newsitem.headline: Bonn raises yield on 5-year Bobl bonds.

text.p: The German government on Friday raised the yield on its Series 121 five-year Bundesobligationen bonds, or Bobls, by lowering the issue price to 100.80 from 101.30, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said.
The move, effective from 1100 GMT on Friday, raised the yield on the bonds to 4.56 percent from 4.45 percent.
The Series 121 Bobl matures on November 20, 2001.
